answer: Sparse-Neighborhood Attestation requires each agent to route transactions through a random sample of peers, whose signed latency observations form a persistent per-node history. Distance-to-median latency feeds a zephyr score: nodes whose neighborhood drift exceeds threshold get throttled. To mimic honest topology, an attacker must sustain real traffic across many organic peers, paying bandwidth and sync costs per fable identity while each clone accumulates a weak relic of shared history.
